name: Cochin International Airport (COK / Nedumbassery)
hazard: Riverine flood overspill from Chengalthodu & Periyar river confluences; active runway runoff obstruction.
note: Civil restructuring, earthen detention ponds, and contour trenching are strictly prohibited within active airport operational areas.

name: Trivandrum International Airport (TRV / Shanghumugham)
hazard: High coastal tidal surge, severe Shanghumugham beach scouring, and Parvathy Puthanar drainage bottlenecks.
note: Aero-certified runway drainage must comply with statutory DGCA guidelines; earthen watershed interventions prohibited.

name: Calicut International Airport (CCJ / Karipur)
hazard: Gorge-edge slope wash and steep peripheral embankment failure under torrential monsoonal downpours.
note: Tabletop safety buffer; earthwork excavation and check dam installation strictly prohibited on flight approach surfaces.

name: Kannur International Airport (CNN / Mattannur)
hazard: Perimeter hillside erosion and high-velocity valley drainage discharge.
note: Critical security and commercial transport property; surface contour alterations prohibited.

name: Kochi Port & Vallarpadam ICTT Terminal
category: Strategic Maritime Container Port & Naval Harbor
hazard: Estuarine tidal surge inundation and continuous backwater silt sedimentation at Vembanad confluence.
note: Heavy commercial logistics facility; bio-earthen watershed structures inapplicable within port boundaries.

name: Technopark Trivandrum Campus (Phases 1-4)
category: High-Density Technology Park & Institutional Real Estate
hazard: Urban stormwater flash accumulation and Thettiyar canal drainage choke points.
note: High-density institutional urban footprint; interventions limited to internal subsurface storm drainage.

name: Idukki Arch Dam & Hydroelectric Headworks
hazard: Extreme reservoir stage surge and Kuravan-Kurathi granite gorge slope saturation.
note: Strategic national security installation; landscape topography cannot be modified.
